apply.title: Apply to the U.S. Digital Corps

what.summary: A two-year federal fellowship for early-career technologists.

evidence.quote: The U.S. Digital Corps is a two‑year fellowship for early‑career technologists

pay.summary: Fellows are paid a federal salary that varies with work location.

evidence.quote: Yes, Fellows’ salary will vary depending on work location according to the Office of Personnel Management’s locality pay tables.

who.summary: Applicants need a certificate or degree from an accredited college, school or qualifying career or technical program; students can apply before they graduate.

evidence.quote: The U.S. Digital Corps can only accept certificates and degrees from accredited colleges, universities, schools, or institutions.
Yes, current students are eligible to apply in advance of their expected graduation or completion date as long as they meet the program eligibility criteria.

status.summary: The application page invites people to subscribe to hear when future applications open.

evidence.quote: Subscribe to our newsletter to get notified when future applications open, as well as for upcoming news, updates, and events.
